queries: SELECT raceId, AVG(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE wins >= 1 GROUP BY raceId

SELECT c.country, AVG(r.avg_points) AS avg_points
FROM (
  SELECT ra.raceId, ra.circuitId, COALESCE(AVG(ds.points), 0) AS avg_points
  FROM races ra
  LEFT JOIN driverStandings ds ON ds.raceId = ra.raceId
  GROUP BY ra.raceId, ra.circuitId
) r
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
GROUP BY c.country;

SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
FROM (
    SELECT c.country AS country, r.raceId AS raceId, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
    FROM driverStandings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
) AS per_race
GROUP BY country;
